proposed_widenings.name: targeting_interception (OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Sanctuary's ongoing operation intercepts targeting attempts by other creatures against the warded creature, then opens a save gate on the attacker. The two existing OngoingOperation variants — roll_modifier (adds a dice bonus to rolls made by the warded creature) and damage_on_hit (adds damage when the caster hits someone in scope) — do not express this shape. A third variant is needed: fires when any hostile creature designates the attachment as its target, requiring an attacker-side WIS save; on fail, the attacker loses the targeting attempt (block_targeting effect).
proposed_widenings.evidence: any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell

proposed_widenings.name: self_break_condition (Duration or SpellMechanicsHeader field)
proposed_widenings.justification: The current Duration discriminated union (instantaneous | concentration | timed) has no way to express early termination triggered by the warded creature's own actions. The v4 lifecycle atom self_break exists but cannot be wired up: SpellMechanicsHeader has no field for it, and Duration.timed has no optional breakOn array. Sanctuary requires 'timed 1 minute + break when warded creature attacks, casts, or deals damage'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

notes: Sanctuary is a Level 1 Abjuration ward cast as a Bonus Action on a single creature within 30 ft for 1 minute (non-concentration). It broadly fits the ongoing_effect family: all SpellMechanicsHeader fields (level, school, castingTime, range, components, duration) are expressible, and the attachment {kind:'target', selection:{mode:'one'}} is valid. The gap is entirely in the operation field: no existing OngoingOperation variant can honestly encode a 'targeting interception gate with attacker-side save'. Using roll_modifier or damage_on_hit would produce a false trace. The self_break_condition is a secondary gap in Duration/SpellMechanicsHeader. Both are surface_widening (new variants of existing types); no new v4 atom is required — block_targeting already exists in v4 to represent the fail outcome, and the save_gate resolution atom covers the WIS check, but the window that opens when a creature designates the target is not reachable from any current OngoingOperation shape.
